title: Resistance mechanism to Notch inhibition and combination therapy in human T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
model: DND-41 T-ALL cells, GeCKO v2 genome-wide knockout library (119,461 guides, 1,000 non-targeting), 21-day drug treatment
contrast: GSI (DAPT) vs DMSO, day 21 (3 vs 3); also CB-103 vs DMSO (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: 48 genes at FDR 0.10 for GSI vs DMSO (17 enriched incl. PIK3R1, 31 depleted incl. CDK6, NOTCH1); 16 (all depleted) for CB-103 vs DMSO
barcs_calls: 313 genes at FDR 0.10 for GSI vs DMSO (85 up, 228 down); 88 for CB-103 vs DMSO
named_hits: 6/7 at FDR 0.10 in GSI vs DMSO: PIK3R1 #1, DCAF7 #4, PCGF1 #6, BCL11B #7, CDK6 #8, NOTCH1 #19; PTEN not called (neither in the paper)
verdict: BARCS ranks the paper's resistance gene PIK3R1 first under GSI and recovers 41 of the 48 MAGeCK calls, including CDK6 and NOTCH1; it calls a longer list, and under CB-103 it also calls PIK3R1 (#1), which MAGeCK left at FDR 0.96.
